Record Class TextInspection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.TextInspection
Record Components:
source - original source, retained unchanged
glyphs - complete visible glyphs, copied before publication
public record TextInspection(String source, List<TextInspection.Glyph> glyphs) extends Record
Finds visible characters and their styles in formatted text without drawing it.

Formatting codes occupy positions in the original string but do not draw characters. Use this fixed view to map between those string positions and the visible character shapes, called glyphs. It also records the style and segment belonging to each glyph. Positions use UTF-16 indices, as Java strings do; the view does not change when later registrations change.
